title: Back 4 Blood

anticheat.note: The launch stops at 'Failed to load the anti-cheat module' (highball-db#973). On Windows Easy Anti-Cheat loads a kernel driver, which Wine can't run, and the runtime it ships for Proton on Linux has no macOS build.

provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#973, 2026-11-04), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5 after 1 minute: the game stops at Easy Anti-Cheat's Launch Error screen, 'Failed to load the anti-cheat module'. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't start. The game needs Easy Anti-Cheat, which can't load under Wine on a Mac, so the launch stops at 'Failed to load the anti-cheat module' and no engine or graphics mode changes that.

knownIssues.symptom: 'Launch Error, Failed to load the anti-cheat module' at start, and the game never opens (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: Easy Anti-Cheat can't load under Wine on macOS
